scope: Compiler-only fixes for the two audited result-conversion defects. Source acceptance uses actual XRT, native C consumers and current TinyCC/VFS. Shipping compiler binaries are not replaced. Concurrent IDE changes excluded and preserved.
fixed: Previously inferred T is reused at recursive result conversion boundaries in both semantic and IR inference.
Async method result conversion specializes the actual worker before publication; exact owner Future signatures and virtual overrides remain intact.
safety: Invariant callback inputs, parameter modes, containers and existing Future values remain invariant.
A 256-prefix synchronous OOM scan checks both allocator balances; async worker return allocation failures and ordinary callback invocation are exercised separately.
Independent IR mutations authenticate selected targets, closed input ABIs and direct worker state plans.

costs: Private worker code and corresponding virtual-family slot metadata are generated for adapted signatures.
Existing bound/result-adapter closure costs remain. Ordinary callback result signatures still materialize their C payload on invocation; exact owner callbacks retain the foreign allocation.
performance.claim: No additional Future forwarding layer. This is not a whole-call zero-overhead benchmark claim.

testEnvironment.linuxProvider: Current source TinyCC and serialized current target objects only; real dlopen, VFS enabled, configured to its actual SDK prefix. No resident replacement xlang/XRT implementation.
correctedAcceptanceAttempts: Initial Linux test provider used CONFIG_TCC_STATIC profiling dlopen stubs; replaced by normal Linux dynamic loader configuration.
The next provider retained an obsolete default SDK prefix; rebuilt with the actual prefix and all acceptance rerun.
